scripts.validate: redocly lint control@v1 --config redocly.yaml --lint-config error --format stylish --max-problems 100
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run validate && corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run test:lint-negative
scripts.generate: corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run validate && corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run generate:go && corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run generate:ts
